source_files: https://oops.cs.columbia.edu/data/video_and_anns.tar.gz → oops_dataset/annotations.tar.gz (transition_times.json) and oops_dataset/video.tar.gz (the two mp4 files, streamed)
note: One example is one FailArmy clip with (a) transition_times.json: three annotators' times (s) when the action turns from intentional to unintentional (-1 = not found), and (b) the language annotations: two workers' "goal" and "what went wrong" sentences with extracted subject-verb-object triples. Captions are video-level, so they span the whole clip in the timeline.

went wrong (2): He fell at the top because he lost his balance.

examples.title: Backflip off a boat clips the hull (onsets 4.7–8.4 s, annotators disagree)

timeline.text: goal (1): The guy wanted to do a back flip into the water.
went wrong (1): The guy ended up hitting the boat on the way down hurting himself.
goal (2): Man tries to back flip in to water.
went wrong (2): He hit his head on the boat.
